original_ai_output.title_zh: 夸克瓦索批评蒂努布政府在安全与贫困问题上失职
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚全国民主大会党副总统候选人、前卡诺州州长拉比乌·夸克瓦索在高原州乔斯市的一场招待会上批评总统博拉·蒂努布领导的政府在处理不安全与贫困问题上失职。他称政府未能保护民众生命、改善尼日利亚人福祉，不配获得连任。该活动由中带青年委员会为奥比/夸克瓦索竞选组合组织，原定由该党总统候选人彼得·奥比主持，但他未出席。

key_facts.fact: 夸克瓦索批评蒂努布政府在安全与贫困问题上失职
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Rabiu Kwankwaso has faulted President Bola Tinubu’s administration over its handling of insecurity and poverty.

key_facts.fact: 夸克瓦索称政府未能保护生命和改善民众福祉，不配获得第二任期
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: He said the government had failed to protect lives and improve the welfare of Nigerians, adding that it does not deserve a second term.

key_facts.fact: 活动在高原州乔斯市举行，由中带青年委员会组织
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kwankwaso spoke on Friday in Jos, Plateau State at a grand reception and villagehall meeting organisedby the MiddleBelt YouthCouncilforthe Obi/Kwankwasoticket.

key_facts.fact: 原定主持活动的彼得·奥比未出席
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: scheduled to be chaired by the party’s presidential candidate and former Governor of Anambra State, Peter Obi, who was, however, absent.

uncertainties: 目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
彼得·奥比缺席原因未说明
